dedupe_keys.name: form eia 861m formerly eia 826 detailed data

description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes detailed files from the monthly EIA-861M survey of sampled distribution utilities and electricity marketers. The survey was called EIA-826 before February 2017. Files cover electricity sales, revenue and customer counts by state and sector from 1990, net metering from 2011, non-net-metered distributed generators from 2017, and small-scale photovoltaic capacity and generation estimates from 2014. Historical advanced-metering and green-pricing collections ended in January 2017 and April 2014 respectively. The landing page offers XLS and XLSX files and lists July 2026 as the latest monthly period. These are sample-based estimates with state-level adjustments; protected non-bundled service data are not released monthly. Electricity demand and distributed-capacity scenarios can use these observations after the sampling and imputation methods are checked. Access is free through the public download directory. EIA states that its government publications are public domain and requests acknowledgement. Caveats: only landing-page metadata was inspected; no spreadsheets or archives were downloaded, and field completeness and units remain unverified. Related resources are the EIA survey catalogues.
